name: expiry_seller_v4
kind: forward paper test (no orders): every trade is decided by the rules below before its outcome exists
question: the same forward test as expiry_seller_v1, v2 and v3 (every sleeve they run, on the same underlyings, at the same size), settled at the official index close instead of the 15:00-15:29 mean of the recorded one-minute closes
why: audit finding E-01 (P1): Kotak's one-minute index candles go flat (O=H=L=C= the previous close) from 15:15 to about 15:28 every session, so the registered 15:00-15:29 mean is computed partly on stale prints. On the 2026-10-06 NIFTY expiry it missed NSE's official close by -27 bps and flipped both NIFTY trades from profit to loss, and the sleeve rules (cost, consistency, tail) run on that P&L. The histories settle on the official close, so the official close is also the like-for-like comparison
supersedes: expiry_seller_v1, expiry_seller_v2 and expiry_seller_v3 for new trades from 2026-10-10. Those specs are not edited and keep running unchanged in parallel, each on its own ledger, as the recorded comparison of the two settlement rules

source.A4, B4: expiry_seller_v1's history: research branch vrp_trades.csv.gz (quantdesk/research/warehouse_research.py), NSE F&O bhavcopy closes 2019-01 to 2026-09

history.convention: each sleeve's history exactly as in the spec it comes from (D4 and E4 per reference lot, as expiry_seller_v3); evidence class real_eod_approximation
history.caveats: as in expiry_seller_v1, v2 and v3

sleeve_names: new names (the old letter with the spec's version) so a trade id never repeats an id in the v1-v3 ledgers
size: 1 lot (D4, E4: 1 reference lot) per sleeve per underlying, as v1-v3; P&L in rupees per lot
entry: exactly as expiry_seller_v1: the chain tape's snapshot nearest 15:20 within 15:10-15:25 on the eve, real quotes only, out-of-the-money strikes nearest each delta within 0.08, a two-sided quote on every leg, sells at bid - 0.05, buys at ask + 0.05, statutory fees

exit.rule: held to expiry, cash-settled; STT 0.125% of intrinsic value on exercised long legs
exit.settlement_price: the official index close: NSE's published file (ind_close_all), else the 15:29 one-minute close (equal to NSE's official close on every day the L1 evidence audit checked), else Yahoo's daily close; the source is recorded with every settlement
exit.when: on expiry day (from 15:31) only NSE's published file is accepted; the 15:29 close and Yahoo only from the next run on. With no official close yet the trade stays open and the next run tries again: it never falls back to the 15:00-15:29 mean

measured_per_trade: as expiry_seller_v1: P&L, the cost gap against the history's convention at the same snapshot, max loss, margin
rules: as expiry_seller_v1 (cost check from 6 settled trades, consistency from 8, the naked tail rule at 1.5 x the history's worst, a loss beyond a defined-risk sleeve's max loss is a bug, a retired sleeve opens nothing more), on this spec's own settled trades only
eligibility: as expiry_seller_v1 and v3: reported, never applied; the defined-risk sleeve first on each underlying (A4 on NIFTY and BANKNIFTY, E4 on FINNIFTY, MIDCPNIFTY and SENSEX), the naked one only after it has been eligible for 3 months; real money only on the owner's word. History restarts: this ledger begins empty and no v1-v3 trade is carried into it, so every count (6, 8, 10 settled trades, the 3 months) starts from zero at registration
changes: any change is a new spec with its own ledger; this ledger is never edited
